passage.content: Coffee is one of the most popular drinks in the world. It was first discovered in Ethiopia, where a goat herder noticed his animals became energetic after eating certain berries. Today, Vietnam is the second largest coffee exporter on the planet, with most of its production coming from the Central Highlands.
